triage_method: Every julia_surface named in the 39 native/bridge/readback rows was checked against the actual GLLVM module on this branch (grep of src/*.jl for the symbol, then, where a same-named symbol exists, a live functional probe against a real fit_gaussian_gllvm(...) fit -- see tools/core070_postfit_2_batch.jl). No row's required behaviour (full argument set + return shape + guard/rejection classes) exists today; several rows have a same-named Julia function with materially narrower behaviour (predict/residuals/simulate/summary/vcov/nobs/loglikelihood/ordiplot/rotation), which is recorded per-row rather than treated as a match. The 11 compatibility_adapter rows have null r_call/empty comparands in the manifest itself and carry no numeric contract to build against; they are SPEC_DEFECT for this batch, not NEEDS_NEW_JULIA_SURFACE, since there is nothing to build.
source_pins_root_note: sha256 of each pinned R source file under .unlazy/core070-aghq/oracle-source/readback/R, checked fresh by tools/core070_postfit_2_batch.R at run time against argv[1] (the same directory in this repo layout).
loading_technique: No R execution: every one of the 39 rows' r_call requires an actual fitted gllvmTMB_multi object as its first argument (not a bare helper function the way data.R/offset.R's miss_control()/normalise_weights() were), and since no case in this batch has a Julia counterpart to compare a fit against, building and fitting a model would produce no comparand to check. tools/core070_postfit_2_batch.R therefore only regex-confirms each row's r_function_name is genuinely defined (top-level `<-`/`=` function assignment, backtick-name-aware) in its pinned oracle source file, grounding the manifest's R-side claims rather than trusting them blindly. tools/core070_postfit_2_batch.jl is the Julia-side counterpart: isdefined()/kwarg_decl() checks plus live functional probes against a real fit.
julia_surface_status: See each row's `missing_julia_surface` field below and the full runtime evidence in tools/core070_postfit_2_batch.jl's receipt (rows[<key>]).

health_checks.source_freshness: every file in source_pins sha256-matches the source root at run time
health_checks.r_admission: all 39 rows' r_function_name regex-confirmed defined in their pinned r_source_file
health_checks.r_rejected_mutations: >=4 corrupted copies of a real definition confirmed NOT found
health_checks.julia_introspection: tools/core070_postfit_2_batch.jl confirms, for every one of the 39 rows, that the required Julia surface is absent -- by isdefined() for wholly-absent names, by live functional probe (kwarg_decl / try-catch / return-type check) against a real fit_gaussian_gllvm(...) fit for same-named-but-narrower functions
health_checks.contract_freshness: contract sha256 recorded in both runners' receipts for tamper detection
health_checks.reference_commit_pin: both receipts' reference_commit must equal this contract's reference_commit

failure_action: Retain the complete attempt (R: attempt.rds + result.json; Julia: the introspection JSON). Do not relax the exact-regex R admission check to a substring/heuristic match, do not drop a row from expected_row_count, and do not reclassify a row from NEEDS_NEW_JULIA_SURFACE to EXECUTABLE_NOW without re-grepping the current Julia source and updating source_pins.
claim_boundary: Passing this batch establishes that (1) all 39 native/bridge/readback R functions named in the postfit-2 manifest genuinely exist, by name, in the pinned oracle R source at the reference commit, and (2) no Julia surface currently exists to compare any of the 65 corresponding cases against -- a fact about this branch's current state, verified live against the loaded GLLVM module, not an assumption. It does NOT establish any Julia native/bridge fit, any numeric R-vs-Julia parity, or that the 11 compatibility_adapter rows' Julia display adapters exist or render correctly. The postfit-2 manifest area cannot close on this evidence alone; it closes only once the 39 missing Julia surfaces above are implemented and a follow-up batch replaces every NEEDS_NEW_JULIA_SURFACE verdict with a real R-vs-Julia value comparison, and once the 11 compatibility_adapter rows' Julia adapters are independently confirmed to exist (out of scope here, since they carry no numeric contract).
